# NextClasses.in

NextClasses.in is an Indian education platform operated by Fetecart Store in Thrissur, Kerala.

## Main offerings
- Practical generative AI and automation courses
- Spoken English, French, German and public speaking programs
- NEET, JEE, KEAM, AISSEE Sainik School and Navodaya exam preparation
- CBT mock tests and weekly study materials
- Digital prompt libraries and educator toolkits

Official website: https://www.nextclasses.in/
Course catalogue: https://www.nextclasses.in/#courses
Support: support@nextclasses.in
